mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodid, finadd.IS_LAY as isLay, to_char(sale.FIRST_SALE_VDATE,'yyyyMMdd') as startdate, to_char(sale.FIRST_SALE_MDATE,'yyyyMMdd') as enddate FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd, PRD_SALE_PARAM sale WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = sale.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID ='${prodId}'

SELECT lvl.AMT_MAX as startamount, lvl.AMT_MIN as endamount, lvl.YIELD as refaddrate, lvl.CUSTOM_LEVEL as StartCustomerLevel, lvl.custom_level as EndCustomerLevel, lvl.term_min as StartDayNum, lvl.term_max as EndDayNum FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM lvl WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT lvl.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = lvl.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = '${prodType}' AND fin.P_FINPROD_ID = '${prodId}' )
